error_reason: At the first operational step, the agent delegated the core task (watching the last video and extracting the command) instead of performing concrete retrieval or analysis. This violated the plan's requirement to view the video and identify the command. No later step corrected this, so the run never obtained the needed information, leading to the incorrect final answer.

hypotheses.rationale: The agent delegated all critical browsing/video-inspection work instead of extracting the command itself, despite the plan requiring analysis of the last video. This caused the team to never actually view the video or identify the command. Since no subsequent step corrected this, the run ended without the required answer. Earlier Step 0 only set the plan; Step 1 was the first operational step that should have initiated concrete retrieval and analysis but instead offloaded it and stalled progress.
hypotheses.check: Verify that Step 1 did not perform or trigger any concrete retrieval of the video content (e.g., opening the blog post or attempting to analyze embedded media) and instead asked another agent to do a web search and then further delegated viewing of the video, leading to no identification of the command.

evidence.discrepancy: Step 1 assumed that delegating a web search would progress toward video analysis, but it neither performed concrete retrieval nor ensured video viewing. Subsequent steps show delegation continued without actually watching the video or extracting the command. The trace shows no identification of the command before termination.
